meta.name: team-composition-patterns
meta.description: Design optimal agent team compositions with sizing heuristics, preset configurations, and agent type selection. Use this skill when deciding how many agents to spawn for a task, when choosing between a review team versus a feature team versus a debug team, when selecting the correct subagent_type for each role to ensure agents have the tools they need, when configuring display modes (tmux, iTerm2, in-process) for a CI or local environment, or when building a custom team composition for a non-standard workflow such as a migration or security audit.

copy.tagline: 按任务自动搭配agent团队与角色
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要决定任务该用多少agent与哪些角色
copy.tagline_en: Automatically compose optimal agent teams for your tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to size agent teams and assign agent types to roles.

howto.what: 把任务拆成多条工作线,按复杂度给出 1 到 5 人的团队规模建议,并为每个角色指定合适的代理类型(比如审查、调试、开发)。还能配置代理在终端里的显示方式,并提供预设团队模板。
howto.when: 当用户需要决定代理团队的人数、选择团队配置(如审查/功能/调试团队)、为角色挑选代理类型时触发。

say.text: 我要修一个可能有多个原因的 bug,组建一个调试团队。
say.note: 会生成 3 个调试代理。

say.text: 这次改动跨前端、后端和测试,组建一个全栈团队。
say.note: 会生成 1 名组长和 3 名开发代理。

say.text: 用安全团队预设,对整个代码库做一次安全审计。
say.note: 会生成 4 个审查代理。

howto.what_en: Breaking a task into parallel work streams, it suggests a team size from 1 to 5 based on complexity, assigns an appropriate subagent_type to each role, and lets you configure how teammates are displayed in the terminal (tmux, iTerm2, in-process).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to decide how many agents to spawn for a task, choose a preset team config (review, feature, debug, etc.), pick a subagent_type for a role, or set the teammate display mode.

say_en.text: I need to fix a bug with several possible root causes; set up a debug team.
This feature spans frontend, backend, and tests; build a fullstack team.
Run a security audit over the whole codebase using the security team preset.
